description: Laboratory Data and Sewage Flow Data is a dataset listed in Hong Kong open data portal (DATA.GOV.HK), an open data portal, published or maintained by Drainage Services Department. Laboratory data of final effluent quality and flow data in seven sewage treatment plants. Coverage: Hong Kong. The portal files it under the publisher Drainage Services Department. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hk-dgh-portal.
